tools.prompt: Create a 15-second cinematic naval-war-film confirmation scene about a bridge crew witnessing an enemy cruiser's sinking, widescreen 16:9. Photorealistic steel textures, cold late-afternoon daylight and warm screen light, suspense releasing into brisk collective relief. Three coherent shots preserve the bridge—a narrow steel bridge with slanted front windows, a central chart table, and cool overhead lamps; Captain Vale—a woman with cropped dark hair, a navy double-breasted coat, and brass binoculars; lookout—a young man with curly black hair, a navy sailor shirt, and a red headset; helmsman—a woman with a blond braid, a navy sailor shirt, and rolled sleeves; tactical screen—a small square tactical screen with a thick black bezel and amber graphics; enemy cruiser—a pale-gray cruiser with one raked funnel and a white stripe across its bow. 0–5 seconds: close-up, tactical screen, black bezel, shows the enemy cruiser sinking beneath its diagrammed waterline, amber light beside the chart table, slow push in. 5–10 seconds: medium three-shot, Vale with binoculars, lookout with red headset and helmsman with blond braid celebrate together, cool lamps overhead, lively lateral slide across their relieved faces. 10–15 seconds: separate wide establishing shot of the bridge, slanted windows prominent, the crew standing still together in shared relief beside the chart table, gentle ease back into a final hold. Sound: low engine hum, faint electronic tones and relieved cheers; 6–7 seconds, lookout says "Confirmed!" No music. Hold the final still image for the last two seconds. Cool steel-blue shadows, restrained saturation, warm amber highlights; brisk release into calm. No narration, subtitles or text overlays.

story.prose:
Return to a narrow steel bridge with slanted front windows, a central chart table, and cool overhead lamps. Captain Vale, a woman with cropped dark hair, a navy double-breasted coat, and brass binoculars, watches a small square tactical screen with a thick black bezel and amber graphics. Its diagram depicts a pale-gray cruiser with one raked funnel and a white stripe across its bow, listing and sinking below a waterline. The lookout, a young man with curly black hair, a navy sailor shirt, and a red headset, cheers. The helmsman, a woman with a blond braid, a navy sailor shirt, and rolled sleeves, pumps a fist. Vale smiles; all three celebrate.

BIBLE (use these words for these things, every time): captain_vale = a woman with cropped dark hair, a navy double-breasted coat, and brass binoculars; lookout = a young man with curly black hair, a navy sailor shirt, and a red headset; helmsman = a woman with a blond braid, a navy sailor shirt, and rolled sleeves; bridge = a narrow steel bridge with slanted front windows, a central chart table, and cool overhead lamps; sea = an open slate-blue sea with low swells, a flat horizon, and thin overcast; resolute = a dark-gray dreadnought battleship with twin-gun main turrets and a red band around its forward funnel; enemy_cruiser = a pale-gray cruiser with one raked funnel and a white stripe across its bow; tactical_screen = a small square tactical screen with a thick black bezel and amber graphics. Light and grade: Cold late-afternoon daylight, cool steel-blue shadows, restrained saturation, and warm amber screen light; realistic naval-war-film photography..

a young man with curly black hair, a navy sailor shirt, and a red headset
a woman with a blond braid, a navy sailor shirt, and rolled sleeves
story.time: Late afternoon, shortly after the salvo
story.mood: Suspense releasing into collective relief and celebration
story.sound_why: Brief spontaneous cheers and relieved laughter make the celebration human and immediate. Keep the engine hum underneath, with no additional spoken exposition or music.
progression: Back on the same bridge with the same crew, the small tactical screen shows the enemy ship sinking.
carried: The identical bridge layout, Captain Vale, lookout, and helmsman return in their established positions.
The same small tactical screen becomes the focus of the crew's attention.
The enemy cruiser is represented on the tactical screen, retaining its single raked funnel and white bow stripe.
